items.title: UK inflation rises to 3.6% in the 12 months to October 2026
items.summary: The Consumer Prices Index increased from 3.5% in the previous month, according to data from the Office for National Statistics.

items.title: Apis Partners agrees to acquire minority stake in Alchemy Underwriting
items.summary: Private equity firm Apis Partners has agreed to take a minority interest in specialty underwriter Alchemy Underwriting, subject to regulatory approval.

items.title: Raindrop survey finds pension providers sceptical over dashboards
items.summary: Research from Raindrop indicates that a majority of senior pension decision makers believe private tracing tools will outperform pensions dashboards.

items.title: ABI issues cash settlement guidance for home insurers amid regulatory pressure
items.summary: The Association of British Insurers has published new best practice guidance and a consumer guide for home insurance cash settlements following FCA scrutiny.

items.title: InsurX appoints Barnaby Rugge-Price as President
items.summary: The London Market digital insurance exchange InsurX has appointed industry veteran Barnaby Rugge-Price as its new President to support its algorithmic capacity technology.

items.title: Marine trades must improve maintenance paper trails to protect liability cover, says Pen Underwriting expert
items.summary: Marine trades businesses face rising claims costs and court awards, making detailed maintenance logs and proper contractor vetting essential for securing insurer defence.
